evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To assess the practicality of such a fully autonomous software factory, we construct CRBugBench, a new benchmark that evaluates whether review agents detect human-verified bugs.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As human review velocity falls behind agentic code generation, it is tempting to build automated review agents towards a future of "lights-off" software factory with little to no human supervision.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: CRBugBench consists of 1,000 review tasks across 98 open-source GitHub repositories, and 800 additional tasks from proprietary industry repositories at one large company.
